title: Apple WWDC 2022: iOS 16 summary slide
lede: The light version of Apple’s keynote summary grid: pale grey rounded tiles on an off-white ground, with device mockups cut off by the frame.
summary: Pale grey rounded tiles and phone mockups of mixed sizes on off-white, one feature each. WWDC 2022.

source.label: Apple Summary Slides (fan archive): Apple WWDC 2022

evidence.note: Inspected the 1920 × 1080 WebP `[WWDC 2022]-[iPhone]-[iOS 16].webp` from the fan archive [Apple Summary Slides](https://apple-summary-slides.vercel.app/events/wwdc-2022) (Ricky Zhang), which says that all images are screenshots of Apple event videos. The copy is a frame of the event video, not an Apple press file. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear: the light variant of the core look, with tonal tiles on a pale ground and mixed sizes on one grid.

context: Apple announced iOS 16 in the WWDC 2022 keynote on 6 June 2022. Deck.gallery compares the WWDC 22 product highlights with other Apple summary decks ([Deck.gallery](https://www.deck.gallery/blog/apple-bento-grid-decks-roundup/)).
observed: The ground is an off-white. Tiles are a slightly darker pale grey with large rounded corners and narrow even gutters.

Five columns of different widths hold tiles of different heights. Large iPhone mockups run off the top and bottom edges of the frame and are labeled with a heading outside the device (“Live Activities”, “Notification views”, “Multilayered photo effect”).
A central tile carries a large white “iOS” on a blue, green, and yellow gradient. One tile in the top row is black with a colored-confetti pattern and the white “Pay Later” logo.
Labels are short, in a dark sans-serif, centered at the top of each tile: “Next generation of CarPlay”, “Quick Note”, “Redesigned Home app”.
Icons are simple and colored: a yellow note, a green field, an orange house, a blue-green shield.
interpretation: The light ground and pale grey tiles are the version that Apple product pages and most web bento grids copy. The device mockups that break the tile edge are a variation: the grid holds, but some content sits on the ground.
borrow: On a light ground, separate tiles by a small step in grey, not by lines or shadows.
Let one or two large device images span several rows and sit on the ground between tiles.

rights.statement: Frame of an Apple event video; copyrighted by Apple Inc. The fan archive states “All rights reserved by Apple Inc.” No image is stored here.
